mapper.insert: INSERT INTO institution_file_system ( system_code, system_name, description, keshi, group_path, created_by ) VALUES ( #{systemCode}, #{systemName}, #{description}, #{keshi}, #{groupPath}, #{operatorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed As isFixed, description, keshi, group_path AS groupPath, created_by AS createdBy, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT fs.id, fs.system_code AS systemCode, fs.system_name AS systemName, fs.is_fixed AS isFixed, fs.description, fs.keshi, fs.group_path AS groupPath, fs.created_by AS createdBy, fs.created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system fs LEFT JOIN user u ON u.ID = fs.created_by WHERE fs.is_fixed = 1 OR fs.keshi IS NULL OR ( fs.group_path IS NULL AND u.role > 1 ) ORDER BY fs.created_time DESC

SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed As isFixed, description, keshi, group_path AS groupPath, created_by AS createdBy, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system WHERE keshi = #{keshi} ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed AS isFixed, description, keshi, group_path AS groupPath, created_by AS createdBy, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system WHERE keshi IS NULL OR ( keshi = #{keshi} AND ( is_fixed = 1 OR created_by = #{createdBy} ) ) ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed AS isFixed, description, keshi, group_path AS groupPath, created_by AS createdBy, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system WHERE ( keshi IS NULL OR ( keshi = #{keshi} AND ( group_path IS NULL OR group_path = #{GroupPath} ) ) ) ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed AS isFixed, description, keshi, group_path AS groupPath, created_by AS createdBy, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system WHERE keshi IS NULL OR ( keshi = #{keshi} AND ( group_path IS NULL OR group_path = #{GroupPath} ) AND ( is_fixed = 1 OR created_by = #{createdBy} ) ) ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed AS isFixed, description, keshi, group_path AS groupPath, created_by AS createdBy, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system WHERE id = #{systemId}
